escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_underscores\":false}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
